purpose: M04 performance baselines from the Ren Multimodal Intelligence punchlist: the measured quality and speed each later change is compared against. A comparison command (library/tools/baseline_compare.py) re-reads a new measurement and prints the quality and speed delta against each baseline here. Quality metrics compare exact; speed metrics compare within --speed-tolerance (machine load variance is documented in the source reports).

baselines.title: Targeted query: approximately 404x smaller context than a whole-view query, with 32/32 answers correct
baselines.workload: 32 M0 milestone questions (event resolution, boundary precision within 0.125 s, repeat identity, one-second control, abstention honesty) asked over 8 sources (7 GEO podcast sources plus the M0 scratch copy of IMG_1822; report states 12,392 s of footage) via three routes: today_api, whole_view, targeted.

baselines.title: Progressive visual retrieval: 25.4 s first coarse answer versus 446.5 s when detailed verification completes before the answer
baselines.workload: 3 planner-style visual questions ('a laptop on a desk', 'a phone on the table', 'a coffee cup on the desk') over the GEO podcast frame index (1092 sampled frames, one every 10 s, CLIP ViT-L/14). Before arm: search_ranges(temporal=True), answer only when verified. After arm: search_ranges(temporal=False) answers at the coarse tier, verify_ranges computes the detailed tier from those candidates. Cold stores per arm (each pays its own verdicts); equality re-measured on a shared store. Bench: docs/benchmarks/progressive_fidelity_bench.py --json.

metrics.description: after-arm first usable (coarse) answer vs before-arm median 446.5

metrics.name: before_first_answer_s
metrics.description: before-arm first usable answer (verification completes before any answer)

metrics.name: full_fidelity_s
metrics.description: after-arm full fidelity vs before-arm median 446.5 (15% less)

metrics.name: answers_identical_rate
metrics.description: final answers identical cold and byte-identical on shared stores, 3/3

baselines.title: Shared grayscale decode: 47.1 s -> 25.4 s for the same frames
baselines.workload: First 120 s of LC4932.MXF (4K, 23.976 fps), re-encoded to a Ren-owned scratch mp4; captain's media read only. Picture sampler (step 1.03) and VI-03 source sampler (step 1.04) each decoded the whole source at 5 Hz, 180 px short side, greyscale. Machine load 60-80 on 10 cores; an earlier run read 117.3 -> 54.2 s, so walls are noisy and the COUNTS (two decodes became one) are the deterministic measure. Bench: python3 -m library.tools.analysis.bench_shared_decode --json.

baselines.title: Parallel coarse-frame seeks: 135.6 s -> 38.7 s media_decode wall
baselines.workload: Ren-owned scratch project's declared source LC4932.MXF (4K MXF, 4941 s), read only, 25 s frame interval (199 frames), PIPELINE_FRAME_EXTRACT_WORKERS 1 vs 8, measured via the engine's ledger reader and extractor. Same shape on LC4931.MXF (287.6 s, 59 frames): 44.1 -> 17.8 s, all 59 byte-identical. Three runs: 3.51x, 2.77x, 3.24x (machine load spread, CPU time constant). New measurement: ledger media_decode walls for a serial and a waved extraction of the same frames plus sha256 comparison.

baselines.title: Frame-level detector cache: 98.4 s -> 59.6 s for the overlapping wider request
baselines.workload: 90 s Ren-owned scratch copy of LC4932.MXF (960x540 mp4); request 'cell phone' over narrow 0-10 s then wider 0-20 s; producer OWLv2 STANDARD (7.269 s/frame on the M0 fixture); model loaded once before both arms. Narrow request is the control (same 10 frames both arms: 71.7 vs 51.2 s, machine variance). Same request asked a second time costs 0.5 s. Bench: python3 -m library.tools.analysis.bench_demand_analysis --json.

baselines.title: Severe remaining visual retrieval errors: measured visual region-capped recall of approximately 0.0539 after temporal reranking
baselines.workload: GEO vs SEO podcast, 7 MXF camera originals, 181.58 video minutes, one frame index of 1092 frames, on a Ren-owned scratch copy (ren-scratch-retrieval-bench). bin/vep -m library.tools.retrieval_eval with the temporal pass OFF (before: the lane as it ships) vs ON (after). Main at 67ef3f501, re-measured on 02c644d23 with identical numbers. Held-out set is the baseline the brief names; merged set reported alongside. Verification cost: 55 candidate intervals inspected (32 established, 23 rejected), 538.3 s that run, 5.1 s per candidate steady state, 0 model calls on a rerun (verdicts recorded in the M8 store).
